A Rift Echo of magical death — what remains when a powerful spellcaster dies channeling the Veil's energy directly. The demilich-Echo is not a true demilich but a crystallized knot of Veil-stuff shaped by the caster's final spell. It traps death-imprints of those who die near it, absorbing them into itself in a grotesque parody of soul-trapping.
## Traits
**Avoidance.** If subjected to an effect allowing a save for half damage, takes no damage on success, half on failure.
**Legendary Resistance.** 3/day.
**Turn Immunity.** Immune to effects that turn Rift-touched.

## Actions
**Howl.** The rift demirift lich emits a bloodcurdling howl, targeting up to three creatures within 30 feet. DC 15 CON save. On failure, drops to 0 HP. On success, 10 (3d6) psychic.
**Life Drain.** Up to three creatures within 10 feet must succeed on DC 19 CON save or take 21 (6d6) necrotic, max HP reduced by damage taken. Dies if max HP reaches 0.
